redneck.definition: n. a poor White person in the southern United States
redneck.translation: n. 红脖子（指美国南方保守的露天劳动者）；乡下人

redneck first class.definition:
When you are flying in the coach section of an airplane and one or both of the other two seats are unoccupied giving you more room, to stretch, lean or lie down.
> The middle seat was unoccupied on my recent flight home so I got to sit in Redneck First Class

redneck teleprompter.definition:
Crib notes written on a public speaker's hand in order to remind him or her what to say during a speech or interview.
> [Sarah Palin] glanced at her redneck teleprompter during her interview a the [Tea Party] Conference in Nashville.

rednecked.translation:
n. [美国俚语](在美国南部农场做工的)红脖佬；贫苦的白种人佃农；乡巴佬[常带有贬义]
a. = red-necked [亦作red-neck]

rednecks.definition: n. a poor White person in the southern United States
rednecks.translation: n. 乡下人, 农人( redneck的复数形式 )

redness.definition:
n a response of body tissues to injury or irritation; characterized by pain and swelling and redness and heat
n red color or pigment; the chromatic color resembling the hue of blood

rednesses.definition:
plural of redness
n a response of body tissues to injury or irritation; characterized by pain and swelling and redness and heat
n red color or pigment; the chromatic color resembling the hue of blood
rednesses.translation: (redness 的复数) n. 红, 红色
